# @univerjs-pro/bases-dashboard-ui

`@univerjs-pro/bases-dashboard-ui` provides the DOM Pivot View and the 12-column Base Dashboard UI.

## Installation

```sh
pnpm add @univerjs-pro/bases-dashboard-ui
```

Register `UniverBaseDashboardUIPlugin`, import `@univerjs-pro/bases-dashboard-ui/lib/index.css`, and merge the locale file for each language enabled by the host application.

Dashboard charts are selected from Pivot Views. Dashboard widgets also support Base table filters, rich-text-backed text, uploaded images, and Formula Shapes.
